summary.key_theme: 公司憑藉強勁的 Q2 財報與 AI 需求加速成長，股價展現強勢反彈，儘管面臨部分獲利了結與估值過高的質疑。

bullish.title: Palantir (PLTR) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript — Revenue surged 93% year over year as AI demand accelerated across U.S. markets.

bullish.title: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) Deepens Its Role In US Defense Infrastructure

bullish.title: Stock Of The Day: Is Palantir Breaking Out?

bullish.title: 3 Reasons Why Growth Investors Shouldn't Overlook Palantir Technologies (PLTR)

bearish.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK Buys The Dip In NVDA, CRCL, SPCX Stocks – Dumps PLTR, SHOP, RBLX Shares

bearish.title: Palantir's Risk-Reward Ratio Is Not Attractive. Here's Why.

bearish.title: Why Is Palantir Stock Volatile on Monday?

neutral.title: S&P500, Nasdaq, Dow Futures Unchanged After Ending Session Mildly Lower As Investors Brace For Key Inflation Data
